P_calibration.quote: Also, a joint resolution is ordinary legislation subject to presidential signature, so it adds little beyond Congress's existing power to amend the Act.
P_calibration.note: also: Aiding and abetting is covered criminally by 18 U.S.C. §2

P_grandfather_step.quote: Keying the exemption to the date of enactment gives developers every reason to start the largest possible runs before then.
